commands: RUNID="${GITHUB_RUN_ID:-local}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT:-1}"; echo "run-id=$RUNID"; mkdir -p ".prflow/tmp/review/pr-1571/$RUNID"; gh pr diff 1571 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee ".prflow/tmp/review/pr-1571/$RUNID/diff.patch" > /dev/null; echo "diff-rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; wc -l ".prflow/tmp/review/pr-1571/$RUNID/diff.patch"

echo "=== does receiving-code-review.md differ from main? ==="; git diff origin/main...HEAD -- .prflow/prompt-extensions/receiving-code-review.md | head -5; echo "rc-diffcount=$(git diff origin/main...HEAD --name-only | grep -c receiving-code-review || true)"; echo "=== does receiving-code-review.md reference 1445 / cloud-writer? ==="; grep -n '1445\|cloud-writer manifest\|cloud-writer runtime' .prflow/prompt-extensions/receiving-code-review.md | head; echo "=== implement.md 1445 refs ==="; grep …[per-command-truncated]

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
if rm -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled" 2>/dev/null &&
   git status --porcelain -z > ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" &&
   [ -f ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   [ ! -L ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before" ] &&
   git hash-object ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before"; then
  echo "snapshot-ok"
else
  echo "snapshot-failed"; printf '%s\n' disabled > ".prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled"
fi

cd /tmp && rm -rf mbtest && mkdir mbtest && cd mbtest && git init -q -b main && git config user.email a@b.c && git config user.name T && echo x > f && git add -A && git commit -qm base && echo "--- merge-base against nonexistent ref ---"; git merge-base HEAD origin/does-not-exist; echo "rc=$?"; echo "--- git show against nonexistent ref ---"; git show origin/does-not-exist:f; echo "rc=$?"

rm -rf /tmp/mbtest; mkdir /tmp/mbtest; git -C /tmp/mbtest init -q -b main; git -C /tmp/mbtest config user.email a@b.c; git -C /tmp/mbtest config user.name T; echo x > /tmp/mbtest/f; git -C /tmp/mbtest add -A; git -C /tmp/mbtest commit -qm base; echo "--- merge-base vs nonexistent ref ---"; git -C /tmp/mbtest merge-base HEAD origin/does-not-exist; echo "merge-base rc=$?"; echo "--- git show vs nonexistent ref ---"; git -C /tmp/mbtest show origin/does-not-exist:f 2>&1; echo "show rc=$?"

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
